svg.title: Evidence beyond the headline
svg.desc: RELEVANCE CHECK · MEMORY PILOT 20 / 20 stale runs returned no relevant evidence After the file changed, the old note stayed out of the answer. Five synthetic tasks, four runs each. Measures filtering, not task success. CONTROL TASKS · MEMORY PILOT 8 / 8 solved, both ways with and without Vexen Unrelated notes stayed quiet. Both groups solved all control runs. Two synthetic tasks, four runs each. Small sample; no general safety claim.
